The petitioner(s) has filed this writ petition(s) seeking for writ of mandamus to consider his appeal for enhancement of compensation before the arbitrator/1st respondent.

The said application was filed on 25.03.2023 so far the 1st respondent has not taken any action to dispose the application,
therefore, has filed the present writ petition.

2. Mr.R.Ramanlaal, learned Additional Advocate General assisted by Mr.Yogesh Kannadasan,
learned Special Government Pleader fairly admitted that the petition(s) is pending before the 1st respondent from 25.03.2023 and the 1st respondent is directed to issue notice to the petitioner(s)
and also to the competent authority and other rival parties as the case may be and after giving notice to all the parties and after conducting an enquiry, in the manner known to law and dispose of the said application in accordance with law within a https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.34767 of 2023 and etc. batch.
period of two (2) months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
3. With the above, these writ petitions are disposed of accordingly.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Connected Miscellaneous Petitions are also closed.
